This semantic drift justifies keeping the authenticity score lower than the Router's 3.20. The background shell blur is minor (severity 1) and should not heavily penalize the score, but the interface melting is a structural flaw (severity ~2).

This is corroborated by the fine-grained classifier ranking 'sea cucumber' above 'chiton', indicating morphological softness inconsistent with rigid armored plates. Background elements exhibit minor generation blur. The combination of structural boundary failure and semantic ambiguity warrants a score below the mid-reference anchor (3.00).
